name: After Midnight
source:
The line between our world and theirs is blurred after midnight. Strange things tend to happen, most people sleep through it in ignorance. You do not. You are aware and you are exhausted. Eventually, the line between reality and delusion is too blurred to distinguish.

[From [url=https://skylilywolf.itch.io/after-midnight]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
午夜过后，我们的世界和他们的世界之间的界限就变得模糊了。奇怪的事情往往会发生，大多数人都在无知中度过。你没有。你很清楚，而且你已经筋疲力尽了。最终，现实与幻想之间的界限变得模糊而难以区分。

[来自[url=https://skylilywolf.itch.io/after-midnight]Itch.io[/url]]
